verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents broadcasts that send a message to a defined recipient list at a time you specify. It also documents a drag-and-drop email editor and Design Studio for composing, and segments for defining audiences. Hands-on community feedback says building, editing and previewing emails is straightforward. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of choosing a segment as a broadcast's audience in the UI, and detail on send-now versus scheduled send options.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Broadcasts send a message to a list of recipients. Broadcast messages are queued to send to all the defined recipients at a time you specify.
If you go to the Segments page, you'll see segments like "Paying Customers", "Have not logged in recently" and "Unsubscribed".
Building, editing and previewing emails felt straightforward and intuitive.
